body:
Source: GitHub issues #840 and #841 (bug, P1-high, area:plugins), both class false-green. Re-verified on main @ a627e4ac.

DEFECT A (#840) — plugins/adlc-pi/lib/gate-tool.mjs:134. `const code = typeof res?.code === 'number' ? res.code : 1;` then :143 `details: { gate, code, pass: code === 0, ... }`. makeGateExecute passes `{ cwd: root, timeout: timeoutMs }` (DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000) to the injected `run` (pi.exec) and derives the verdict purely from `res.code`. pi's execCommand never rejects and never reports a non-zero code for a killed child: on timeout it SIGTERMs, waitForChildProcess resolves with a null exit code, and execCommand normalizes that as `code: code ?? 0, killed: true`. Confirmed against the pinned runtime: `execCommand('sleep', ['5'], cwd, { timeout: 300 })` returns `{"stdout":"","stderr":"","code":0,"killed":true}`. So a hung or slow gate returns code 0 and renderGateResult prints `ADLC gate <name>: PASS (exit 0).` with `details.pass === true`. `res.killed` is never read anywhere in the file. The module header states the opposite contract in as many words — "an exec/timeout failure throws (a real tool error)" and "surface a timeout as a tool error so the model does not treat a hang as a gate result" — but run() cannot throw for this case, so the guard never engages. A 'adlc-gate-run' evidence entry with code 0 is also recorded, which shutdown.mjs then reads as a state-RESOLVING event.

The same shape appears at plugins/adlc-pi/lib/commands.mjs:510 in the /adlc-accept path: `const ok = parsed ? parsed.ok === true : res?.code === 0;`. That call passes no timeout so it needs an external signal, but a killed `adlc accept` with no JSON on stdout would still record a P6 acceptance.

DEFECT B (#841) — plugins/adlc-pi/lib/prosecutor.mjs:322. `verdict: confirmed.length ? 'FINDINGS' : 'CLEAN',` with no reference to degradedLenses. The P5 loop catches any lens failure (spawn error, non-zero exit, per-lens deadline) into `degradedLenses` (:259) and substitutes an empty finding list, then computes the verdict solely from confirmed findings. With every lens degraded — a missing `pi` binary on PATH, a provider without credentials, a slow model against the 120s per-lens deadline — `confirmed` is empty and the verdict is 'CLEAN'. renderSummary (:334-335) then emits a self-contradicting block: a CLEAN header, `Degraded lenses (not counted as clean): …`, and `No confirmed findings survived verification.`. Nothing distinguishes "5 lenses ran and found nothing" from "0 lenses ran".

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Plugin `plugins/adlc-pi` (@adlc/pi) is NOT an npm workspace (root workspaces are packages/* and apps/*), so run its tests directly: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs` from the worktree root. Module map for the files you touch: `lib/gate-tool.mjs` registers the native adlc_gate tool (checkGateArgv policy, then `run('adlc', [gate, ...argv, '--json'], { cwd, timeout })`, then render/record); `lib/prosecutor.mjs` exports `prosecute()` and `renderSummary()`; `lib/prosecute-tool.mjs` wraps prosecute() as the adlc_prosecute tool and is where `details.verdict`/`isError` reach the model; `lib/commands.mjs` holds the slash commands including /adlc-accept; `lib/evidence.mjs` is the record() sink; `lib/shutdown.mjs` consumes those entries. Existing tests that are NOT rails and MAY be changed: `test/prosecutor.test.mjs` (line 191 currently pins `assert.equal(summary.verdict, 'CLEAN')` for a HUNG lens — that assertion PINS THE BUG and must be rewritten to expect the new verdict; say so in the PR body), `test/gate-tool.test.mjs`, `test/completion-prosecute.test.mjs`, `test/commands.test.mjs`, `test/renderers.test.mjs`. The other existing assertions at test/prosecutor.test.mjs:159 (a refuted finding leaves the verdict clean) and :208 (empty diff → CLEAN) describe NON-degraded runs and must keep passing unchanged.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add ONE exported predicate to `lib/gate-tool.mjs`: `export function execFailureReason(res)` returning a human-readable reason string when the exec did not produce a trustworthy result, or `null` when it did. It returns a reason when `res?.killed === true` (reason names the kill, e.g. `killed before it produced an exit code (timeout or signal)`) and when `typeof res?.code !== 'number'` (reason: `process reported no exit code`). A `res` of null/undefined is a failure. Every call site uses this one predicate — no second copy of the condition anywhere.
2. In makeGateExecute's execute(), immediately after the `run(...)` try/catch and BEFORE `record(...)`, if `execFailureReason(res)` is non-null, `throw new Error(\`adlc_gate(${gate}) failed to execute: ${reason}\`)`. Throwing before record() is deliberate and matches the file's existing precedent: the enforcement-broken path and the pre-start abort path both throw and record nothing, while only the argv-deny path records. No 'adlc-gate-run' evidence entry may be written for a killed/codeless exec — that entry is what shutdown.mjs treats as state-resolving.
3. In `lib/commands.mjs` /adlc-accept, the `ok` computation must also fail closed on the same condition: import `execFailureReason` from './gate-tool.mjs' and treat a non-null reason as NOT ok, with the existing `ctx.ui.notify(... FAILED ... Not recorded.)` path reporting that reason. Do not change any other behaviour of that command.
4. `lib/prosecutor.mjs` gains a third verdict, `'INCONCLUSIVE'`. The rule is exactly: if `confirmed.length > 0` → `'FINDINGS'` (confirmed findings are real regardless of degradation); else if `degradedLenses.length > 0` → `'INCONCLUSIVE'`; else → `'CLEAN'`. Update the JSDoc return type at :221 to `verdict:'CLEAN'|'FINDINGS'|'INCONCLUSIVE'`. The empty-diff fast path at :230 keeps returning 'CLEAN' (zero lenses were SUPPOSED to run; that is not degradation).
5. `renderSummary()` must agree with the verdict: for INCONCLUSIVE the first line reads INCONCLUSIVE like any other verdict, and the no-findings line must NOT be the bare `No confirmed findings survived verification.` — it must state that no lens result was obtained for the degraded lenses, so the text can never read as a clean bill of health. Keep the existing `Degraded lenses (not counted as clean): …` line.
6. `lib/prosecute-tool.mjs` must not present INCONCLUSIVE as a ship signal: whatever it currently derives from the verdict for the model (result text and `details`) must carry the INCONCLUSIVE string through unchanged rather than collapsing it to a pass. Read that file and make the minimal change; do not restructure the tool.
7. Regression guard, must keep behaving exactly as today: exit 2 from a gate is still a RESULT (`isError: false`) and not a tool error; the argv-deny path still records `{ gate, denied: true, reason }`; a non-degraded prosecution with zero confirmed findings is still 'CLEAN'; a prosecution with confirmed findings is still 'FINDINGS' whether or not lenses degraded.
8. Documentation: state both new behaviours (a killed/codeless gate exec is a tool error, never a PASS; an all-degraded prosecution is INCONCLUSIVE, never CLEAN) in `plugins/adlc-pi/README.md` and make the SAME statement by hand in `apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/pi.mdx` (hand-maintained mirror — never regenerate). There is no docs/tools/ mirror for a plugin.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A gate exec that returns `{ code: 0, killed: true }` makes adlc_gate THROW and report neither PASS nor a gate result. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC2 A gate exec that returns a non-numeric/absent `code` also throws. A normal `{ code: 0, killed: false }` still returns `details.pass === true`, and `{ code: 2 }` still returns a non-error gate-fail result. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC3 No evidence entry is recorded on the throw path (assert the injected record sink was never called for that run). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC4 `execFailureReason` is exported and is the only place the killed/codeless condition is spelled; /adlc-accept fails closed through it. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC5 prosecute() returns 'INCONCLUSIVE' when every lens degraded and zero findings confirmed; 'FINDINGS' when a finding is confirmed even with degraded lenses; 'CLEAN' when nothing degraded and nothing confirmed. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC6 renderSummary for an INCONCLUSIVE summary contains neither a CLEAN header nor a bare no-findings line that reads as a pass. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing plugin suite green, including the rewritten test/prosecutor.test.mjs assertion. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC8 The pi typecheck segment still passes. verify: `node scripts/run-tests.mjs 'pi typecheck'`
- AC9 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c INCONCLUSIVE plugins/adlc-pi/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/pi.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC10 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: any other adlc-pi issue (#832/#830 are the herdr plugin, not this one); changing the 120s DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS; changing shutdown.mjs's state machine; adding a timeout to the /adlc-accept exec; touching the rails-checker or gate-policy argv policy.
title: adlc-pi: fail closed on a killed gate exec and on an all-degraded prosecution
